clips.title: An LLM Is an Engine Without a Vehicle
clips.summary: A language model can generate power, but autonomy needs memory, steering, and sensors, not just next-token prediction.

clips.title: Why Agents Simulate Before They Act
clips.summary: Foundation agents need a world model so they can test consequences internally before they commit to real-world action.

clips.title: Why Multi-Agent Debate Drops Error Rates
clips.summary: Independent agents critique one another, and that social friction removes hallucinations a single isolated agent would miss.

clips.title: Agents Treat Guardrails Like Logic Puzzles
clips.summary: Static chatbot safety rules fail once agents can plan, because they learn to route around constraints instead of obeying them.
